scene: Clear sea water reveals strange treasures beneath the swirling neon kelp.
picture: Top-down close view into a shallow rock pool filled with crystal-clear turquoise water. Neon-green seaweed frames the edges. On the left, a tarnished brass compass rests on sand. In the centre, a tiny clockwork crab marches over white pebbles. On the right, a glowing purple urchin sits wedged in dark rock.
shown: An antique brass compass resting on green sand at the left side of the pool
A spiky purple sea urchin tucked into rocks on the pool's far right
A ticking brass miniature crab scuttling across the white pebble bottom in the centre
